atoms.b: The axes are the lines on the bottom and ((number ++side)) of the bar chart. They show us the scale and categories of a bar chart.
Bar charts can have different scales. The scale of this bar chart goes from 0 to ((10 ++20)).
The bars show the ((++number scale)) of a certain category on the bar chart.

instruction.text: In Georgie’s class, 16 children have dogs, 8 children have cats, 4 children have fish and 12 children have hamsters as pets. Finish filling in this bar chart to show this.
